_doc: Imperium Astra event-banner lines (presentation only; DialogueLines / DialogueBanner). Keys are stable event kinds from TurnController.game_event plus UI variants (roll_bot, doubles, jail_exit_*, trade_*). Each value is a list of variants; one is picked at random. Placeholders: {name} acting commander, {other} other commander, {owner} deed holder, {space} space display_name, {amount} / {price} money with currency sign, {text} card text from data/cards.json, {deck} deck name from board.json terms, {d1} {d2} {total} dice. A new theme copies this file and rewrites the strings only; missing keys fall back to plain English built into DialogueLines.

match_start: The Senate convenes. {name} takes the first turn.
landed_unowned: {space} lies unclaimed. {price} to plant the eagle.
auction_won: The Forum falls silent: {name} takes {space} at {amount}.
auction_unsold: No bids. {space} stays with the Treasury.
rent_owed: {name} owes {owner} {amount} in tribute at {space} and must raise it.
{owner} demands {amount} from {name}; the coffers run short.
jail_enter: {name} is clapped in irons and sent to the Brig!
The Praetorian Guard escorts {name} to the Brig.
jail_exit_fine: {name} pays the fine and walks free.
jail_exit_doubles: Doubles! {name} breaks out of the Brig.
jail_exit_forced: Third try: {name} pays up and leaves the Brig.
bankrupt: {name}'s empire falls. The banners are lowered.
